dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave trailing edge forming a smooth curve from the dorsal insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape with a narrowly rounded tip radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, moderate-radius convex curve extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Visible short, thick beak protruding from the cranial base with a high thickness-to-length ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct concave transition point between the melon and rostrum forming an obtuse interior angle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlighting across the dorsal-lateral flank and trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
